gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Tube-bent letters with a splayed c terminal give Tilt Neon its commanding, constant-width look. Noto Sans Tagbanwa, a plain sans with open curves and clear gaps, feels like a quiet room beside it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supp: Tube-like strokes, loud and unwavering: that is Tilt Neon. The heading shouts best in big, short bursts, while Noto Sans Tamil Supplement, a sans-serif with tall, round forms, does the steady talking.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh, a sans-serif with rounded, inviting letters, sits comfortably under the tube-bold Tilt Neon heading. Over many lines its inflated bowls keep the text soft and welcoming.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Commanding, tube-like letters set the tone in Tilt Neon. The heading is best when large and loud, while Noto Sans Ugaritic, a sans-serif with chalk-arc openings, is best at quieter, friendlier talking.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-yi: Modern, wire-bent letters define Tilt Neon, which is best big and short. Noto Sans Yi, a sans with a deep midsection and unlatched round curves, takes over the rest.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-radio-canada: A tube-like, constant-width stroke gives Tilt Neon its look. It earns its keep big and short, while Radio Canada, a sans-serif with tall, full lowercase curves, carries everything else.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-siliguri: Wide-eyed, sharp and unmistakable: Unica One announces itself. Hind Siliguri, a sans-serif with a flat gray hum of constant line weight, gives that shout a steady, approachable partner underneath.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-go: Large-eyed letters, uniform in stroke: Unica One. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi, a plain sans with crayon-tall lowercase and cut-back terminals, gives it a chunkier, friendlier partner on the page.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-mro: A very large lowercase eye makes Unica One instantly recognizable. Noto Sans Mro, a sans-serif dense and tall in the middle, settles into a compact, steady texture once the text runs on.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-saira: Daylight in every curve: that is Unica One. Saira, a plain sans with see-through s shapes and rounds stretching high toward the top line, makes extended text feel light and quick.
